summary: Full E2E test of KUN Workspace new features: booking normalization + admin PATCH, availability admin controls, media library uploads, meeting-room availability enforcement, booked-slots public endpoint, theme toggle, MediaPicker UI. 51/51 backend pytest tests pass (including 15 new tests). All admin pages render correctly with data-testid theme-toggle-btn switching dark/light. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: Availability validation order: 'اليوم غير متاح للحجز' (working-day check) runs before 'هذا التاريخ مغلق' (blocked-date check). So a date that is BOTH non-working-day and in blocked_dates returns the working-day error. Minor UX — consider checking blocked_dates first since it's a more specific admin action.
Public endpoint exposes full admin-configured blocked_slots list. Fine for this use case, but if sensitive dates ever need hiding, add a filter.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/backend/routes/public.py book_meeting_room, swap the order so blocked_dates check runs before working_days check for clearer error messages.
OPTIONAL: The ContentBlockIn schema still has 'key' field (from previous iteration); main agent chose to keep it Optional for convenience. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py upload_media: the UploadFile.read() loads entire file in memory before size check — for >10MB uploads this still buffers briefly; consider stream + size cap via request.headers['content-length']. Low priority.
routes/public.py book_meeting_room: uses naive datetime.strptime on user input and a weekday conversion ((d.weekday()+1)%7). Works but add an assertion/comment clarifying Sun=0 convention.
storage.py init_storage caches _storage_key globally but never rotates/refreshes. If Emergent storage key expires, uploads will fail until process restart.
routes/admin.py _normalize_booking mutates the input dict via .pop() — safe here since doc is a fresh Mongo result, but consider deep-copy if ever reused.
routes/public.py serve_media does not set ETag/Last-Modified — cache-control only. Minor perf.
AvailabilityDoc.working_days default is [0..6] and end_time='23:59' — effectively 24/7 open. Intentional for backward-compat (so pre-existing tests pass). Good.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_kun_api.py (replaced hardcoded date with randomized to avoid 409 flake from stale data)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all checked flows: login, theme toggle, bookings with resolved names + inline actions, availability page, media library with uploaded file, offices page)

seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_-prefixed bookings/offices/rooms/messages/users/media. Availability is reset to permissive defaults (24/7, no blocks) after class-scoped restrictive fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 3 pytest files in /app/backend/tests (test_kun_admin.py, test_kun_api.py, test_kun_new_features.py) — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. 51 tests green. New features validated: (a) PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id} works for legacy flat bookings via _normalize_booking; (b) GET /api/admin/bookings enriches office_name/room_name from respective collections when IDs match; (c) POST /api/admin/media/upload → emergent object storage, returns {id, storage_path, url:/api/media/file/..., size, content_type}; rejects non-image 400, >10MB 413, unauth 401; (d) GET /api/media/file/{path} serves bytes with correct content-type, 404 on missing; (e) GET/PUT /api/admin/availability with default fallback; (f) POST /api/bookings/meeting-room rejects blocked_date/non-working-day/outside-hours/blocked_slot with 400 (Arabic detail) and duplicate with 409; (g) /api/booked-slots?room_id&date returns {room_id,date,booked:[HH:MM,...]}. Frontend: theme-toggle-btn works (toggles html.dark class, localStorage persisted); Availability and Media admin pages render; Bookings table shows localized type labels (قاعة اجتماعات/مكتب خاص/مكتب مشترك) and resolved names where IDs match; legacy TEST_ seed bookings show raw room-1/office-1 IDs because those don't match real UUIDs — acceptable fallback. Public /spaces calendar was not browser-tested due to time but the backend GET /api/availability and /api/booked-slots endpoints feed it correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — original 500 error on booking status update is fixed. Root cause was BookingOut pydantic schema enforcing details:Dict, while legacy docs stored num_desks/office_id/room_id/etc. flat. Fix (confirmed working): _normalize_booking in routes/admin.py folds flat fields into a details sub-dict before BookingOut(**doc). Verified end-to-end: a desk booking (which used to be flat in older code) PATCH to status=confirmed returns 200, not 500.
